structure_policy_rationale: Original 图标主体为清晰的文字 Logo '爱奇艺' 和图形 'i'。根据主题规则，当 Original 为清晰几何或文字符号时，应保留其拓扑结构。因此，必须保留 'i' 的基本笔画结构和闪电的位置关系，但需将精细的文字转化为粗犷的手绘块面，去除原有的渐变背景和标准字体规范。
preserve: 'i' 字母的基本形态（上方圆点，下方竖条/矩形）
右下角闪电符号的存在及其相对位置
must_preserve: 'i' 字母的基本形态（上圆下竖）
右下角闪电符号的存在
recompose_allowed: 将标准印刷字体重构为不规则的粗马克笔手写体
将原本的绿紫渐变背景替换为纯黑
将闪电的锐利直角处理为圆润的钝角或不规则边缘
调整 'i' 与闪电的大小比例以适应居中构图 (50-70% 画幅)
restyle: 应用复古手绘涂鸦质感（蜡笔/马克笔笔触）
边缘处理为毛糙、抖动的非标准化线条
内部填充改为高饱和度纯色块，无渐变
forbid: 禁止保留原有的绿色/紫色渐变背景
禁止使用细线条或完美的几何圆角
禁止出现立体高光、阴影或3D渲染效果
禁止直接照搬原始的标准印刷字体
禁止使用主题色板之外的颜色（如绿色、紫色）
generation_brief: A retro hand-drawn doodle icon on pure black background. Subject is a simplified, thick-stroked letter 'i' in brick red, with a yellow lightning bolt at the bottom right. Rough marker pen texture, uneven edges, naive art style. Flat colors, no gradients, no shadows. Heavy black outlines.
color_application: Map original brand identity to theme palette: 'i' shape uses high-saturation Brick Red; Lightning bolt uses Warm Yellow/Naihuang; Background is Pure Black (#000000). Remove all original green/purple gradients.
stroke_application: Apply thick, irregular, hand-drawn black/dark outlines to both the 'i' shape and the lightning bolt. Edges should appear shaky and clumsy, simulating a rough marker or crayon stroke.
composition_application: Center the combined 'i' and lightning symbol. Ensure the subject occupies 60-70% of the canvas. Maintain clear separation between elements using color blocks rather than shadows. Keep ample black negative space around the subject.
identity_application: Preserve the topological structure of the 'i' (dot + vertical bar) and the presence of the lightning bolt to maintain brand and 'Lite' version recognition, but render them in the crude, simplified doodle style.
fidelity_constraints: Must add thick hand-drawn style outlines
Colors must be limited to Red, Blue, Yellow/White high-saturation flat fills
No gradients, shadows, or realistic textures allowed
Subject must be flattened geometric block combination
negative_constraints: Do not keep original green/purple gradient background
Do not use thin lines or perfect vector curves
Do not include 3D rendering, gloss, or lighting effects
Do not use standard printed fonts
Do not drift into other styles (e.g., neon, minimalist vector, photorealistic)
